Thanks again for the call earlier today — great alignment on scope and success metrics. Per our conversation, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW for your internal review. Key items for alignment: 

- Proposed target close: 2026-09-30
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-10-07 (we flagged one-week buffer for legal/DocuSign)
- Milestones (high level):
  1) Technical POC sign-off (FinTechCo) — target 2026-09-20 — Owner: Jordan
  2) Security review (SOC 2 artifacts) — target 2026-09-22 — Owner: Priya
  3) Commercial and legal redlines — target 2026-09-25 — Owner: FinTechCo legal + Redwood legal (Dev)
  4) Final procurement approval & signature — target 2026-10-07 — Owner: FinTechCo procurement

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC 2 evidence (we can provide our latest report), any required DPA updates, and final SLA exceptions if requested. Please review the attached MAP (FinTechCo_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and SOW draft. 

Could each of you confirm owners and whether the 9/30 target close and 10/7 signature deadline are workable? If procurement needs an earlier signature date, let me know — we can attempt to compress the commercial/legal cycle.

Next steps:
- Jordan/Priya: confirm owners & procurement timeline by 9/14
- Camila: I’ll loop CS on onboarding tasks once signature is confirmed
- Dev: please stand by for legal redline coordination

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quarter.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwoodinference.com
https://www.redwoodinference.com
